title: Demo approval pending task
objective: Create a deterministic goal with a real coordinator-owned task that pauses at an approval gate so the operator UI can show a concrete pending action.

initial_tasks.title: Run a guarded demo action
initial_tasks.prompt: Run the guarded demo action only after the coordinator approval gate is resolved by an operator.
initial_tasks.reason: The bootstrap should leave one actionable approval visible in the SPA and TUI without requiring the operator to paste UUIDs.
